linkedin.title: The biggest problem with the news today isn't that there is too much of it.
linkedin.body:
It is that most of it is irrelevant to your specific life, work, and interests. We are constantly bombarded with headlines that demand our attention but offer nothing in return. This leads to noise, not knowledge.

True information isn't about reading everything. It is about reading the right things at the right time. When you filter out the clutter, you actually get a clearer picture of the world. You stop guessing what matters and start understanding why it matters to you.

Personalisation, when done right, is just a tool for focus. It respects your time by learning what you actually care about, rather than guessing based on mass-market trends. It turns the overwhelming firehose of global news into a steady, useful stream of insight.

We built Headlinne to prove that you can stay informed without feeling overwhelmed.

beats.caption: Several key factors hurt the GOP.
beats.detail: From oil prices to data centers.

beats.caption: Trade policy created significant voter doubt.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Democrats swept aside the Republican majority, leaving the president with limited legislative power.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The shift creates uncertainty for global markets, inflation, interest rates, and economic growth.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Keep an eye on how the president navigates the final two years of his term.

story_card.caption:
